▰ INSTITUTIONS //

Six of Canada's largest banks — BMO, CIBC, National Bank, RBC, Scotiabank and TD — are jointly exploring a Canadian-dollar tokenized deposit solution.

The first phase focuses on moving tokenized deposits across participating financial institutions, with a longer-term goal of connecting the infrastructure to emerging digital-asset initiatives.
